incident.title: FATAL: connection pool exhausted at 100/100 connections

analysis.probableCause: Insufficient connection pool size and/or inefficient connection reuse
analysis.recommendedAction:
1. Increase the connection pool size to accommodate the expected load.
2. Implement a more efficient connection reuse strategy (e.g., using a connection pooling library).
3. Monitor and analyze database query performance to identify potential bottlenecks.
